notes.title: Smashpunks On Steam Playtest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34993678/0518cf410e2ba25511d2aeceae620c249218f2e2.jpg[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1016830/Smashpunks/]Smashpunks is free to play for a limited time via Steam Playtest![/url] If you’re looking for frenetic vehicular melee combat then now’s the perfect time to jump in and start playing! 

Smash, crash and bash your friends in hectic online matches where players battle to carry the highly prized FlagBot to their team’s goal. Not as easy as it sounds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34993678/9d717550beb3814548e56b77bd5d44cedb7ba002.jpg[/img]

Request a free Steam Playtest key of Smashpunks from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1016830/Smashpunks/]store page[/url], help us to test the game and best of all, take part in some unique and epic online battles!

Remember, this is for a limited time only so [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1016830/Smashpunks/]grab a key[/url] and start smashing!
